title: Sanguozhi V
overview:
Sangokushi V is an authentic historical simulation focused on the people. The setting is China in the 2nd and 3rd centuries AD. As a ruler, you command the generals under you and aim to unify the continent.

Game Features
- Introduces the new elements of "winning the people's hearts" and "fame." Capturing the hearts of the residents is the key to how events unfold, putting a close-up on the residents who support the Sangokushi world. A ruler's "fame," closely tied to the people, rises through the results of "councils" and decisions made in various events. As fame rises, the number of commands increases and, above all, it becomes the shortcut to unification.
- 12 types of "formations" that change the battle, such as direct attack and mobile types. There are 12 formations in all, including direct attack, indirect attack and mobile types. They also differ by direction, and choosing the formation that suits your plan gives you the advantage, unfolding endlessly varied battles.
- An enhanced officer system that can be assigned by department, such as domestic affairs and diplomacy. The officer system, previously used only for domestic affairs, has been enhanced so that the generals under you can be fully assigned to departments such as diplomacy and military. Domestic affairs and military are handled by local administration in each city, while diplomacy and personnel are centralized, demanding careful selection of talent.
- 32 kinds of varied special abilities that sway the course of battle, such as fire attacks and sorcery. There are 32 in all, including stratagem types such as "Fire Attack" and "Confusion," special attacks such as "Volley," and "Sorcery" that only certain generals can use. Use them effectively and your chances of victory rise.
- Thrilling one-on-one duels.
- A multi-scenario system with 7 scenarios, including the "Yellow Turban Rebellion" appearing for the first time in the series, and play for up to 8 players.
- 20 BGM tracks in all (music by Takayuki Hattori)
